name: Hagborn
publication: Book of Heroic Races: Player Races 1 (2015)
traits: Constitution +2. Medium, with a 30-ft. walking speed. Darkvision 60 ft. Speaks, reads and writes Common.
Proficient with claws. An unoccupied hand can attack for 1d4 slashing using Strength or Dexterity via finesse. A hand holding a weapon or shield, or occupied with spellcasting, cannot claw.
Green Hagborn: Intelligence +2. Choose dancing lights, mage hand or minor illusion as an Intelligence-based cantrip. Green hagborn often have a slight green cast to their skin.
Night Hagborn: Charisma +1. Proficiency in Deception and advantage when impersonating another person. The source describes dark-blue to deep-purple skin.
Sea Hagborn: Strength +1, Athletics proficiency and a 20-ft. swimming speed. Their fingers and toes are webbed.

name: Samsaran
publication: Book of Heroic Races: Player Races 1 (2015)
traits: Intelligence +2. Medium, with a 30-ft. walking speed. Matures at a human pace and can live up to 500 years. The lineage is understood through repeated incarnations.
Darkvision 60 ft. Lifebound grants resistance to necrotic damage and advantage on saving throws against necrotic damage.
Shards of the Past grants one proficiency from Animal Handling, Arcana, History, Medicine, Nature or Religion. Speaks, reads and writes Common and Everborn.
Companion lineage: Wisdom +2. On one check per day, gain proficiency with a chosen set of artisan’s tools for that check. Can cast comprehend languages as a ritual.
Dreaming lineage: Dexterity +1, advantage on History checks, and proficiency with one weapon of the player’s choice.
